source_text:
7.6 Καταδιώξαι α ρα ὁ ἐχθρὸς τὴν ψυ
χήν μου, καὶ καταλάβοι.
Ινα χοϊκὸς, ἀντὶ ἐπουρανίου, γενοίμην.
pass_a_gloss: Let-pursue then the enemy the soul of-me, and let-him-overtake. In-order-that earthy, instead-of heavenly, I-might-become.
pass_b_english: “Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it” (Psalm 7:6).
So that I might become earthy, instead of heavenly (1 Corinthians 15:47-49).

choices.why: Paul’s pair (1 Cor 15:47-49). Not ‘dusty instead of of-the-sky’ as mere physics.
rejected: dusty instead of of the sky

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
